Advisory Announcement

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Matt Olson, Area Management Biologist 907-459-7274 (Fairbanks) Toll free fishing schedule and counts: 1-866-479-7387

2026 Yukon River Salmon Fall Fishery Announcement #28 Reminder: Return 2026 Salmon Fishing Permits

Districts Affected: Upper Yukon Area

Yukon Area subsistence and personal use salmon fishing permits expired on October 15 and harvest reporting is due by October 25 for the permit areas listed below. Even if you did not fish or did not catch any fish, a harvest report must be completed.

• Yukon River: Rampart, Yukon River Bridge, Circle, and Eagle

• Tanana River: Subdistrict 6-A (Manley), Subdistrict 6-B (Nenana/Minto), and Personal Use in

Subdistrict 6-C (Fairbanks/North Pole).

A subsistence fishing permit is required to fish for all species year-round in the Yukon River permit areas listed above. If you plan to continue subsistence fishing in the remainder of the year, please call the Fairbanks office at (907) 459-7274 to report preliminary harvest and request a permit extension.

Harvest reports can be completed online at www.adfg.alaska.gov/harvest by entering your daily harvest. For permits with a weekly reporting requirement (Tanana 6-B and 6-C), remember to select the ‘I’m Finished, Submit Harvest Report’ button after entering your daily harvest to close out the permit. If you did not fish this season, select the 'Click here to mark permit as not fished' button.

Alternatively, reporting can be completed by returning your permit to ADF&G 1300 College Road, Fairbanks, AK 99701. Failure to report harvest information may result in denial of a household permit next year.

Thank you for your cooperation in managing Yukon Area fisheries resources.

-end-
